name: teamcall
description: Move a company's people from the chat window to a terminal agent in 30 days, and measure it: a pilot charter from 5 people to 30-50 with a one-page set-up for IT, a 20-minute fast path per person, a 5-hour champion path, the same task turned into one command (termboost), one short card a day in Telegram or WhatsApp from the company's own bot (how to lead an agent and approve its steps; done / show me / skip, nothing to install), a transition journal, a report on six measurements (time, quality, coverage, repeatability, new capability, what a person checks) with the minutes of human help per first working result and the card answers, a scale-or-stop page, and which seat already pays for which terminal agent. It counts and plans; it buys nothing.
